features.note: 3U chassis, both 19in ears (the mass drift x +42.6 mm is exactly the ears — a critical feature, the one explicit X exception in the new on-device guard). Envelope 0.4400 x 0.1310 x 0.6665 m, exact to spec on all three axes. Bottom edge is now clean — the floating slot that hung below the chassis floor is gone (see defects).
Display reads as recessed glass, lit on (PANDUIT / INPUT / OUTPUT / BATTERY, no numbers or units). Dominant panel element on a front face that now clearly leads the composition.
Collared button + 4 green LEDs (power on). Both are also the literal interactive hotspots.

Front grille rebuilt to FIT: VENT_H 0.018 -> 0.009, tighter pitch, so all three slots sit within the 32.5 mm available under the display instead of the third one hanging 18.7 mm below the chassis. Reads via the stamped lip; the 18 side-vent slots carry the flank; the rear fan bore + ring read on the rear view.

important_features.note: Deep 666 mm body reads; at el 8 the side keeps 26% of the frame carrying the depth while the front leads.

defects: FOUND AND FIXED AT P6 (had existed since the BLOCKOUT, survived 6 passes and 3 gates INCLUDING MINE): the third front vent slot hung 18.7 mm BELOW the chassis floor, floating in air (three 18 mm slots at 22 mm pitch need ~66 mm; only 32.5 mm exists under the display). Nothing caught it because verifyVentsAreRecessed measured ONLY z-depth (a slot at the right depth in the wrong PLACE is still 'recessed'), and every framing/containment check boxes the WHOLE subject without asking whether that box describes ONE connected object — a detached piece does not break a bounding box, it silently enlarges it. Fixed, plus a new guard verifyPartsAreOnTheDevice(root): every named part must fall within the chassis envelope in absolute Y (a 3U that protrudes fouls its rack neighbours), in X with one explicit exception (the 19in ears), Z unchecked (bezel + service panel protrude by design). Negative control: reintroducing the defect fires the guard.

CAMERA MOVED as a direct consequence (elevation 10 -> 8): the framing metric derives from the subject bbox, and removing the floating piece dropped the true box from 0.1497 to 0.1310 m in Y. At the old angle the feature-less top face then tied the front (38%/38%) — the 'front 40%' reported at the blockout was INFLATED by the defect. At el 8: front 41% / top 33% / side 26%, front leading honestly.

OPEN ITEM (sustained, not a defect): rear receptacle layout unbuilt and unsourced — P1 §2 covers form factor, dimensions, rating and the FRONT face only. rear_panel renders solely the functionally-forced parts (rear_service_panel, rear_fan_bore, rear_fan_ring); the receptacle count/type is not asserted, and the rear view makes that absence visible rather than hidden.
corrections: None for the standalone asset. Scene/library: apply the corrected occlusion pick() (per pdu DEFERRED-CORRECTIONS) and carry verifyPartsAreOnTheDevice + the boot check into any reused block.

mechanical.notes: 10/10 headless suites pass, including boot.mjs on the real main.js. Console clean (0/0) across default, power=off, rear (captured --page, dpr3). Envelope exact. Mass drift accounted: ears x +42.6 (critical), bezel 6 mm + seated service panel z +13.7, y +0.0. 4/4 criticals with complete named geometry, 7 declared materials with 0 spec drift all actually rendered, display carries no numerals/units. p6_comparison spec-only (references/ empty on disk, no fabricated reference-match). 16 cached geometries. Guard errors: 0. Reachability legend verified bidirectional in --page (front: button/display/chassis reachable, service panel dimmed; rear: the reverse).

notes: FINAL gate — inline orchestrator judgment. The ups-panduit asset is COMPLETE. It had the bumpiest ladder of the five (blockout FAIL on framing+state, interaction FAIL on a boot abort, and a floating vent slot that survived to P6), but every fault was caught and fixed with a NEW PERMANENT GUARD (init-at-boot, boot.mjs, verifyPartsAreOnTheDevice), and the final asset is honest and correct: exact envelope, all criticals complete, disciplined display text, and a sustained open item (rear receptacles) held honestly rather than invented. HONEST NOTE ON MY OWN JUDGING: I gated this asset's framing SIX times against a bounding box corrupted by the floating slot, and I almost certainly saw that piece in the lower-front of earlier captures and read it as 'the service panel' without measuring it — the inverse of measure-before-reporting: measure a suspicious element, do not assume it away. The builder's verifyPartsAreOnTheDevice guard is the durable fix for the whole class. Cleared. Remaining run work: Axis, FMPS, and the scene assembly.
